sentences.text: Catenoleimus was a mid-sized enantiornithine bird, a type of ancient bird, estimated to measure between 20 and 25 centimeters in length.
Analysis of its coracoid bone — a key shoulder element — reveals primitive traits when compared to other Enantiornithes from that era.
Scientists have uncovered only one fossil specimen of this species, consisting of a single coracoid bone discovered in Uzbekistan.
Taxonomically, Catenoleimus belongs to the parent group Alexornithiformes.
It is also classified under the broader class Reptilia.
This creature lived approximately 90 million years ago during the mid-late Turonian stage.
The fossil record for Catenoleimus spans a period from 93.9 to 89.8 million years ago within the Turonian epoch.
